scope: Belica Void Drone actor and target-event recovery; not production integration
findings: The GA/GE/GMMC/GCN filename-selected corpus omitted the Drone actor Blueprint even though its raw asset was already extracted. Direct Blueprint class imports identify this dependency without re-extracting the game.

The authority-guarded actor path registers DroneUpdateTargets on a repeating timer with a serialized interval of approximately 0.15 seconds. It loops candidate targets and performs a line trace; the blocked branch removes GE_LtBelica_Drone_ManaDrain and the unblocked branch adds the target and applies that effect from the instigator ability system, with the Drone as source object.

The target ability listens for ability commits with AbilityType.Ability and for Event.OnDamaged. Its damage-event branch requires GameplayEffect.LtBelica.VoidDrone.TriggerDamage and equality between the event instigator and the instigator of the stored Drone damage spec.

FireDroneLaserAtTarget resolves the Drone from the granting context source object and requests a serialized approximately 0.1-second latent Delay before applying ZapDrain and the stored GE_DamageSpec to the target ability owner. It does not construct a fresh damage spec at this application site.
A separate approximately 0.01-second WaitDelay in activation ends in an execution-flow return; it must not be mistaken for automatic firing or the zap delay.

The recovered ManaDrain default is Infinite and contains an attribute-based ManaRegen modifier capturing target Mana without snapshot. Its legacy GrantedAbilities entry has a null Ability, while GEComponents is populated: that legacy entry alone cannot establish the effective ability grant.
limits: Timer and latent-action runtime behavior, repeated-call coalescing/cancellation and same-frame ordering remain unverified.
Actor defaults, overlap radius, effective target-ability grant components, team enum interpretation, lifecycle and native damage-category eligibility require further recovery.
Stored-spec reuse does not by itself certify context identity or native application copying on every zap.
No in-game measurement was made. Instruction byte agreement is not whole-asset/default/native certification.
Production still approximates one immediate damage packet per damaging activation; this recovery does not yet change simulator damage or live data.
next: Recover ManaDrain gameplay-effect components and the target ability grant/removal lifecycle.
Trace the native latent Delay contract and repeated-trigger behavior before generating Drone hit events.
Combine conditional hit delivery with Noxia identity and Combustion eligibility; then rebuild the production comparison.
